groups.observed: Left source S is a small radiating star-like light mark inside a large rectangular housing. Short radiating strokes and a right-going illumination fan are visible.
K labels a pair of upright centrally thick lens elements at the housing's right wall. The two facing curved profiles and their short interior diagonal marks remain distinguishable.
D is a narrow upright framed slide just to the right of K, with a diagonal leader from its label.
O labels the smaller lens farther right. It sits in a stepped/rectangular tube extending from the slide area, ending in an upright exit rim.
An unlabeled tall vertical screen stands at far right, beyond the objective.

Directed illumination paths run S to K to D. Multiple paths run from the slide through O, crossing in the objective region, then spreading to the screen; the outer upper/lower paths end well above/below the narrow slide extent.
